title: ResearchExportState
description: Per-project export and import bookkeeping, stored in the coordinator state directory.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

imported_at.title: Timestamp
imported_at.description: When the one-time import from the checkout's export ran.

last_export_at.title: Timestamp
last_export_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

last_export_redactions.description: Fields the last export replaced because they looked like secrets.

items.title: ExportDrift
items.description: An export file that was edited by hand. The edit was saved here and the file rewritten from the canonical records.

detected_at.title: Timestamp
detected_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

files.description: SHA-256 of every file the last export wrote, by path relative to `.ablationkit/`. Used to detect hand edits and to remove only files AblationKit wrote.
